permissions.comment: opener:default covers only mailto:/tel:/http:/https:, so Directions would silently no-op without these. geo: is what gives Android a chooser across every installed navigation app instead of forcing Google Maps; maps: is the iOS equivalent, dormant until there is an iOS target.
The public origin only. The dev machine's LAN address is added by dev-lan.json, which tauri.dev.conf.json enables for `npm run tauri:dev` and `npm run tauri:android:dev` — never for a release build.
`getCurrent` and `onOpenUrl`, for App Links to ourdriveway.com (the emailed links and a bank's return), declared in tauri.conf.json under plugins.deep-link.mobile. Desktop registers nothing.
